title: Security Context Dies at Boundaries
summary_en: After spending enough time reviewing security-sensitive systems, individual vulnerabilities start looking less individual. The technologies change. One bug is in a browser-facing development server. Another is in a WebSocket stream.
excerpt: After spending enough time reviewing security-sensitive systems, individual vulnerabilities start looking less individual. The technologies change. One bug is in a browser-facing development server. Another is in a WebSocket stream. Another appears in an identity platform. Another lives inside SSRF protection. Another is buried in a DeFi oracle calculation. Yet the same structural failure keeps appearing: > **_A security property exists on one side of a boundary, but does not survive the transition to the other side._** Identity disappears.
